statement.excerpt: If we assume that half of that gets built, that’s still $875 billion in annual revenue that will be needed to keep these data centers from running out of money as their margins are atrocious and they’re all paid for with onerous debt.

our_interpretation: The antecedent concerns half of the referenced 190GW project pipeline, rather than half of all existing data centers.
The claim concerns annual revenue required for cash sustainability after that capacity is built.
The preceding price-times-capacity calculation is an estimate, not an observed cash break-even calculation.
No deadline is supplied for this particular conditional claim. The surrounding 2030 discussion does not establish a completion deadline for this exact project cohort.
Revenue requirements must include operating payments, debt service, and necessary replacement expenditure, with external financing distinguished from operating sustainability.
criteria.support_condition: After half of the identified pipeline becomes operational, comparable project financial records establish that approximately $875 billion annually is required to meet ongoing cash obligations.
criteria.contradiction_condition: After the antecedent is established, comparable records show that the built cohort can sustainably meet its obligations at materially less annual revenue, or establish a materially different break-even requirement.
